entry.title: Resolution 619 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County): — → Adopted
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO PROVIDE A GRANT TO KU‘IKAHI MEDIATION CENTER INC. FOR ITS CONFLICT PREVENTION AND RESOLUTION TRAINING SERIES

Transfers $3,000 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 5)
